text: I am created in the image of God and I carry His likeness in everything I do.
bibleVerseText: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them.

text: I am blessed by God to be fruitful, to multiply, and to have dominion in the earth.
bibleVerseText: God blessed them and said to them, 'Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it.'

text: I am a masterpiece because everything God made in me is very good.
bibleVerseText: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.

text: I have the breath of life from God inside of me, making me a living soul.
bibleVerseText: Then the Lord God formed a man... and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.

text: I walk in the garden of God's presence and I enjoy fellowship with Him every day.
bibleVerseText: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God as he was walking in the garden.

text: I walk faithfully with God and our friendship grows deeper every day.
bibleVerseText: Enoch walked faithfully with God.

text: I find favor in the eyes of the Lord even in the middle of a difficult world.
bibleVerseText: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.

text: I am a blessing to others and my name is great because God has blessed me.
bibleVerseText: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.

text: I am not afraid because God is my shield and my very great reward.
bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.

text: I am counted as righteous because I believe in the promises of the Lord.
bibleVerseText: Abram believed the Lord, and he credited it to him as righteousness.

text: I serve the God Who Sees Me and He knows exactly where I am and what I need.
bibleVerseText: She gave this name to the Lord who spoke to her: 'You are the God who sees me.'

text: I walk before God Almighty and I am being made blameless by His power.
bibleVerseText: I am God Almighty; walk before me faithfully and be blameless.

text: I serve a God for whom nothing is too hard or impossible.
bibleVerseText: Is anything too hard for the Lord?

text: I am a friend of God and He reveals His plans and His wisdom to me.
bibleVerseText: Then the Lord said, 'Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?'

text: God is with me in everything I do, granting me success and victory.
bibleVerseText: God is with you in everything you do.

text: The Lord is my provider and He sees to it that all my needs are met.
bibleVerseText: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide.

text: I receive a hundredfold return on what I plant because the Lord blesses me.
bibleVerseText: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the Lord blessed him.

text: The Lord is in this place and He is watching over me wherever I go.
bibleVerseText: Surely the Lord is in this place... I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go.

text: I wrestle for my blessing and I do not let go.
bibleVerseText: I will not let you go unless you bless me.

text: I have a new identity in God and I am an overcomer in every situation.
bibleVerseText: Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome.

text: I am a prosperous person because the Lord's presence is always with me.
bibleVerseText: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered.

text: I have the Spirit of God in me, giving me discernment and wisdom above others.
bibleVerseText: Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God?

text: God has made me fruitful in the land of my struggle and I am moving forward.
bibleVerseText: It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering.

text: What the enemy meant for my harm, God is turning around for my good.
bibleVerseText: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good.

text: I am not afraid because God provides for me and my family.
bibleVerseText: So then, don't be afraid. I will provide for you and your children.

text: I am delivered from every form of bondage because the Lord has heard my cry.
bibleVerseText: I have indeed seen the misery of my people... I have heard them crying out... and I have come down to rescue them.

text: The Great I AM is with me, providing everything I need for my journey.
bibleVerseText: God said to Moses, 'I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: I AM has sent me to you.'

text: I am still and I trust God because He fights this battle for me.
bibleVerseText: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

text: I am moving forward in faith and the obstacles in front of me are parting.
bibleVerseText: Then the Lord said to Moses, 'Why are you crying out to me? Tell the Israelites to move on.'

text: The Lord is my strength and my song; He has become my total victory.
bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my defense; he has become my salvation.

text: I serve the Lord who heals me and keeps my body in perfect health.
bibleVerseText: I am the Lord, who heals you.

text: I have fresh provision every single morning because God is my provider.
bibleVerseText: The Israelites... gathered it each morning, as much as they needed.

text: The Lord is my Banner and I win every fight under His leadership.
bibleVerseText: Moses built an altar and called it The Lord is my Banner.

text: I am God's treasured possession and I am set apart for His holy purpose.
bibleVerseText: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession.

text: I honor my parents and I live a long and blessed life.
bibleVerseText: Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land.

text: I worship the Lord alone and His blessing is on my food and water.
bibleVerseText: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water.

text: God is taking all sickness away from me and my family.
bibleVerseText: I will take away sickness from among you.

text: I live a full life and fulfill the number of my days on earth.
bibleVerseText: I will give you a full life span.

text: God is sending His angels ahead of me to guard me and lead me to my destiny.
bibleVerseText: See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

text: I am an overcomer because God goes before me and confounds my enemies.
bibleVerseText: I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter.

text: I am skillful and talented because God has filled me with His Spirit and wisdom.
bibleVerseText: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills.

text: The presence of God goes with me and gives me total rest.
bibleVerseText: The Lord replied, 'My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.'

text: I am distinguished and different from the world because God is with me.
bibleVerseText: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me... unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people?

text: I serve a God who is compassionate, gracious, and slow to anger.
bibleVerseText: The Lord, the Lord, the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.

text: I am seeing wonders and miracles in my life that have never been done before.
bibleVerseText: Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world.

text: I shine with the glory of God because I spend time in His presence.
bibleVerseText: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai... his face was radiant because he had spoken with the Lord.

text: I am a generous giver and I bring my best to the work of the Lord.
bibleVerseText: All who were willing and whose hearts moved them came and brought an offering to the Lord.

text: I have a heart that is willing to learn and a mind that is quick to understand.
bibleVerseText: And he has given both him and Oholiab the ability to teach others.

text: The glory of the Lord fills my life and my home like a cloud of protection.
bibleVerseText: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

text: I follow the leading of the Lord whether by day or by night.
bibleVerseText: So the cloud of the Lord was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night.

text: I am holy and set apart because the Lord my God is holy.
bibleVerseText: Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.

text: I love my neighbor as myself and I treat everyone with kindness.
bibleVerseText: Love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord.

text: I walk in God's ways and I receive the rain of blessing in its season.
bibleVerseText: If you follow my decrees... I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops.

text: I have so much provision that I clear out the old to make room for the new.
bibleVerseText: You will still be eating last year's harvest when you will have to move it out to make room for the new.

text: I live in a place of peace and I lie down without any fear.
bibleVerseText: I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid.

text: I am victorious in battle and my enemies fall before me.
bibleVerseText: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

text: I am mighty in God — five can chase a hundred and a hundred can chase ten thousand.
bibleVerseText: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand.

text: God looks upon me with favor and makes me fruitful and productive.
bibleVerseText: I will look on you with favor and make you fruitful and increase your numbers.

text: The Lord walks among me; He is my God and I am His own.
bibleVerseText: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

text: I walk with my head held high because God has broken the chains of my past.
bibleVerseText: I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk with heads held high.

text: I am consecrated to God and I keep myself pure for His use.
bibleVerseText: Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the Lord your God.

text: I do what is right and I live safely in the land God has given me.
bibleVerseText: Keep all my decrees and laws and follow them, so that the land... will not vomit you out.

text: I distinguish between what is holy and what is common in my daily life.
bibleVerseText: You must distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean.

text: I honor the elderly and show respect for those who have gone before me.
bibleVerseText: Stand up in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God.

text: I am honest in all my business dealings and I use fair weights.
bibleVerseText: Use honest scales and honest weights, an honest ephah and an honest hin.

text: I am the Lord's and I belong to Him forever.
bibleVerseText: You are to be holy to me because I, the Lord, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.

text: I celebrate the goodness of God and I am full of joy in His presence.
bibleVerseText: Rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.

text: The fire of God is always burning on the altar of my heart.
bibleVerseText: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.

text: I am a person of integrity and I do not cheat or lie to my neighbor.
bibleVerseText: Do not steal. Do not lie. Do not deceive one another.

text: I do not hold a grudge, but I forgive from my heart.
bibleVerseText: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against anyone among your people.

text: I walk in love and I never put a stumbling block in front of others.
bibleVerseText: Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block in front of the blind.

text: I stand for justice and I do not show favoritism to the great or the small.
bibleVerseText: Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great.

text: I am a faithful tither and I honor God with the first of my increase.
bibleVerseText: A tithe of everything from the land... belongs to the Lord; it is holy to the Lord.

text: I am released from my debts and I walk in the year of Jubilee.
bibleVerseText: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land.

text: I am safe and secure because I walk in the ways of my God.
bibleVerseText: Follow my decrees and be careful to obey my laws, and you will live safely in the land.

text: I am taking possession of every place where I set my foot, just as God promised.
bibleVerseText: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

text: No enemy can stand against me all the days of my life because God is with me.
bibleVerseText: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

text: I am strong and courageous because the Lord my God is with me wherever I go.
bibleVerseText: Be strong and courageous... for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

text: I meditate on God's Word day and night and I am prosperous and successful.
bibleVerseText: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night... Then you will be prosperous and successful.

text: I do not turn to the left or to the right; I stay focused on the path of victory.
bibleVerseText: Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.

text: I am crossing my Jordan and entering into the fullness of my inheritance.
bibleVerseText: Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them.

text: The obstacles in my path are moving because I follow the presence of the Living God.
bibleVerseText: As soon as the priests who carry the ark of the Lord... set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off.

text: I am consecrated to God and I expect Him to do amazing things in my life.
bibleVerseText: Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you.

text: I serve the God who is exalted, and He is making my name great in the land.
bibleVerseText: Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel.

text: I have a memorial of God's faithfulness that reminds me He will always provide.
bibleVerseText: These stones are to be a memorial to the people of Israel forever.

text: The reproach of my past is rolled away and I walk in a new identity.
bibleVerseText: Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.

text: I eat the fruit of the land and I enjoy the abundance of my current season.
bibleVerseText: They ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.

text: I am standing on holy ground and I am aligned with the Commander of the Lord's army.
bibleVerseText: Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.

text: I shout in victory because the Lord has given me the city and the breakthrough.
bibleVerseText: Shout! For the Lord has given you the city!

text: The walls of opposition are falling down flat before me.
bibleVerseText: When the trumpets sounded... the wall collapsed.

text: I am not afraid or discouraged; I take my position and claim my win.
bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai.

text: I am reaching out my hand in authority and God is giving me the victory.
bibleVerseText: Stretch out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city.

text: The sun and moon stand still for me until my mission is fully accomplished.
bibleVerseText: Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and you, moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.

text: I am putting my feet on the necks of my enemies; I have total dominion.
bibleVerseText: Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.

text: I am as strong today as I was years ago; I am ready for the battle.
bibleVerseText: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I'm just as vigorous to go out to battle now.

text: I am bold enough to say: Give me this mountain!
bibleVerseText: Now give me this hill country that the Lord promised me that day.

text: Not one of God's good promises to me has failed; every one has come true.
bibleVerseText: Not one of all the Lord's good promises to Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.

text: I hold fast to the Lord my God just as I have done until this day.
bibleVerseText: But you are to hold fast to the Lord your God, as you have until now.

text: As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord.
bibleVerseText: But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord.

text: I am a witness to God's goodness and my heart is fully committed to Him.
bibleVerseText: Yield your hearts to the Lord, the God of Israel.
